cytrabackups.config.storagePath:
Where backups are stored. Relative paths are resolved against the server folder (the game folder in singleplayer,
where a per-world subfolder is added). Keep it outside the world folder.
cytrabackups.config.storagePath.name: Storage path
cytrabackups.config.workerThreads: Worker threads for hashing/compression/IO. 0 = auto (half the CPU cores, max 4). Threads run at low priority.
cytrabackups.config.workerThreads.name: Worker threads
cytrabackups.config.maxReadMiBPerSecond: Limit how fast backups read the world, in MiB/s, to protect server disk I/O. 0 = unlimited.
cytrabackups.config.compression.algorith: zstd (recommended), deflate, or none. Already-compressed data is always stored as-is.
cytrabackups.config.compression.level: deflate: 1-9. zstd: 1-22 (needs the bundled native zstd; the pure-Java fallback has one level, about zstd 3).
cytrabackups.config.compression.minSavin: Keep the compressed form only if it saves at least this many percent.
cytrabackups.config.compression.recompre: Unpack each chunk's data and store it with zstd and a dictionary trained on real chunks: about 24 percent smaller than Minecraft's own zlib. The first backup after turning this on or off re-reads the whole world. Needs the bundled native zstd (Windows, Linux, macOS x64/ARM64); backups made this way need CytraBackups 1.5 or newer.
cytrabackups.config.compression.chunkLev: zstd level for recompressed chunks, 1-22. 15 is the sweet spot: 19 saves another half a percent at half the speed.
cytrabackups.config.chunkDedup:
Store .mca region files chunk-by-chunk so a region with one changed chunk only stores that chunk again.
false = store region files whole (still deduplicated when completely unchanged).
cytrabackups.config.chunkDedup.name: Chunk dedup
cytrabackups.config.trustModificationTim: Reuse the previous backup's data for files whose size and modification time did not change (much faster).
cytrabackups.config.include: Glob patterns (relative to the world folder) to include. Empty = everything. '**' spans folders.
cytrabackups.config.include.name: Include
cytrabackups.config.exclude: Glob patterns to exclude. Patterns without '/' match a file name at any depth. Excludes win over includes.
cytrabackups.config.exclude.name: Exclude
cytrabackups.config.minFreeSpaceMiB: Abort a backup cleanly when less than this much free space (MiB) would remain on the storage disk.
cytrabackups.config.minFreeSpaceMiB.name: Minimum free space (MiB)
cytrabackups.config.flushOnSave: Run 'save-all flush' before each backup (recommended; briefly blocks the server thread while chunks are written).
cytrabackups.config.flushOnSave.name: Flush on save
cytrabackups.config.timeZone: Time zone for daily times and daily/weekly/monthly pruning buckets, e.g. "Europe/Berlin". "system" = server default.
cytrabackups.config.timeZone.name: Time zone
cytrabackups.config.schedule.intervalMin: Minutes between automatic backups. 0 = disabled (use timesOfDay only).
cytrabackups.config.schedule.timesOfDay: Additional fixed daily times in 24h "HH:mm" format, e.g. ["04:00", "16:00"].
cytrabackups.config.schedule.startupDela: Minimum minutes after server start before the first automatic backup.
cytrabackups.config.schedule.backupOnSto: Back up while the server is stopping (after the final save).
cytrabackups.config.schedule.backupWhenL: Back up when the last player leaves.
cytrabackups.config.schedule.onlyIfPlaye: Skip automatic backups unless at least one player was online since the previous backup.
cytrabackups.config.schedule.skipIfUncha: Skip automatic backups when nothing changed since the previous one.
cytrabackups.config.schedule.unchangedIg: Files ignored by the 'nothing changed' check (they are rewritten on every save).
cytrabackups.config.prune.enabled.name: Enabled
cytrabackups.config.prune.intervalMinute: Minutes between automatic prune runs (also runs after each automatic backup when due).
cytrabackups.config.prune.keepLast:
Keep rules are combined: a backup survives if ANY rule keeps it. Set all to 0 to keep everything
(then only maxAgeDays / maxTotalSizeGiB delete). Pinned backups are never pruned.
cytrabackups.config.prune.keepLast.name: Keep last
cytrabackups.config.prune.keepHourly: Keep the newest backup of each of the last N hours.
cytrabackups.config.prune.keepDaily: Keep the newest backup of each of the last N days.
cytrabackups.config.prune.keepDaily.name: Keep daily
cytrabackups.config.prune.keepWeekly: Keep the newest backup of each of the last N weeks.
cytrabackups.config.prune.keepMonthly: Keep the newest backup of each of the last N months.
cytrabackups.config.prune.maxAgeDays: Delete unpinned backups older than this many days, even if a keep rule matches. 0 = off.
cytrabackups.config.prune.maxTotalSizeGi: Delete the oldest unpinned backups until the store is below this size (GiB, deduplicated). 0 = off.
cytrabackups.config.prune.keepPreRestore: Keep automatic pre-restore backups for preRestoreMaxAgeDays regardless of other keep rules (0 = forever).
cytrabackups.config.prune.preRestoreMaxA: Days to keep automatic pre-restore backups when keepPreRestore is on (0 = forever).
cytrabackups.config.prune.garbageCollect: Delete blobs no longer referenced by any backup after pruning.
cytrabackups.config.restore.confirmTimeo: Seconds a restore confirmation link stays valid.
cytrabackups.config.restore.countdownSec: Broadcast countdown before players are kicked and the server stops for a restore.
cytrabackups.config.restore.applyMode:
When to apply a restore that needs the world closed:
  "startup"  = stop the server; the restore is applied on the next start before the world loads (hosts that auto-restart).
  "shutdown" = apply right after the server has saved and stopped, then stay stopped (hosts that do not auto-restart).
cytrabackups.config.restore.livePartialR: Try to restore chunk selections live (unload, write, reload) when no player is near. Otherwise queue for restart.
cytrabackups.config.restore.liveUnloadTi: Seconds to wait for the selected chunks to unload before giving up on a live restore.
cytrabackups.config.restore.recycleBinKe: How many previous restores keep their recycle bin (for /cbackup rollback).
cytrabackups.config.restore.maxChunks: Maximum chunks in one partial restore.
cytrabackups.config.progress.bossBar: Show a boss bar while a job runs.
cytrabackups.config.progress.actionBar: Show progress in the action bar.
cytrabackups.config.progress.showTo.name: Show to
cytrabackups.config.progress.announceSch: Broadcast a chat message when an automatic backup finishes.
cytrabackups.config.discord.enabled: Post notifications to a Discord webhook.
cytrabackups.config.discord.enabled.name: Enabled
cytrabackups.config.discord.webhookUrl: Discord channel webhook URL (Channel settings > Integrations > Webhooks).
cytrabackups.config.discord.onRestore: Post when a restore or rollback is scheduled or applied.
cytrabackups.config.discord.onLowDisk: Post when free disk space drops below lowDiskWarningMiB.
cytrabackups.config.discord.onPrune.name: On prune
cytrabackups.config.discord.lowDiskWarni: Warn when free space on the storage disk drops below this many MiB.
cytrabackups.config.discord.failureMenti: Optional text prepended to failure messages, e.g. "<@&123456789>" to ping a role.
cytrabackups.config.offsite.enabled: Copy backups to off-site storage after they are created.
cytrabackups.config.offsite.enabled.name: Enabled
cytrabackups.config.offsite.type.name: Type
cytrabackups.config.offsite.mirrorDelete: Also delete remote copies when backups are pruned/deleted locally.
cytrabackups.config.offsite.keepLocalCop: Keep the backup data on this server as well. Off (off-site only): every backup is uploaded while it is made and deleted here afterwards, so only the backup list and a small upload buffer use local space. Restores, verify and export then download what they need. Needs off-site copies enabled.
cytrabackups.config.offsite.localBufferG: Off-site only: most GiB of backup data waiting for upload on this server. A backup that produces more data waits for the uploads.
cytrabackups.config.offsite.uploadThread: Uploads and downloads at the same time (1-32; SFTP always uses 1). Backups are stored as many small pieces, so more at once is much faster.
cytrabackups.config.offsite.s3.endpoint: e.g. https://s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net (OVH, region gra/sbg/bhs/de/uk/waw), https://s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com, https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, https://s3.us-west-004.backblazeb2.com
cytrabackups.config.offsite.s3.region: Region name used for request signing, e.g. gra for OVH, us-east-1 for AWS, auto for Cloudflare R2.
cytrabackups.config.offsite.s3.pathStyle: Path-style URLs (endpoint/bucket/key). Needed for MinIO and most self-hosted services.
cytrabackups.config.offsite.sftp.host: SFTP server host name or IP.
cytrabackups.config.offsite.sftp.passwor: Login password (not needed with a private key).
cytrabackups.config.offsite.sftp.private: Path to a private key (relative to the server folder). Used instead of the password when set.
Passphrase of the private key, if it has one.
cytrabackups.config.offsite.sftp.remoteD: Remote folder for the backups (created if missing).
cytrabackups.config.offsite.sftp.hostKey: "tofu" = trust the host key on first connect and pin it (stored next to the backups), "yes" = known_hosts only, "no" = never check.
cytrabackups.config.offsite.webdav.url: Base URL of the target folder, e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/me/backups/
cytrabackups.config.permissions.defaultL:
Op level required for each permission when no permissions mod (e.g. LuckPerms) decides.
Permission nodes are cytrabackups.<name>.
cytrabackups.config.permissions.level: Op level (0-4) needed for cytrabackups.%s when no permissions mod decides.
